statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-59873 is a decompression/parse DoS that requires the application to extract an attacker-supplied tar archive with node-tar. The AIS relay (scripts/ais-relay.cjs) is a network gateway: AIS over WebSocket, OpenSky over REST polling, Telegram over MTProto, and RSS/JSON feed proxying. It never extracts tar archives. node-tar is present only as a transitive build/tooling dependency; its extract code path is unreachable at relay runtime.
